preconditions: Owned project roots on a local Linux filesystem; cooperating processes use the same native project-root mutex.
steps: Acquire writer/recovery guards, observe owner records, exercise competing child processes and verify owned release.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Befehlsgruppe `specroad lock` MUSS mit `status` die vollständigen Lock-Metadaten ausgeben und mit `recover --force` aktive Eigentümer desselben Hosts abweisen sowie bei fremdem oder nicht prüfbarem Host zusätzlich `--accept-remote-risk` verlangen.
oracle.scope: Native library locking and conservative read-only status; no CLI commands, transaction engine, distributed lock or authorization claim.

open_items: Integrate the complete command/transaction and journal-recovery engines; verify remaining supported target runtimes and filesystem assumptions.
Explicit orphan recovery and its audited risk policy follow in 5.i.R.
